mapper.sql: SELECT id, user_id, name, enabled, available, disable_reason, trigger_key, definition, create_time, update_time FROM workflow
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled}, available = true, disable_reason = NULL, trigger_key = #{triggerKey}, definition = #{definition, typeHandler=com.generalbot.workflow.typehandler.WorkflowDefinitionTypeHandler}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
